subject: Future Tech
title: When Will AVs Be Everywhere?
description: A 60-second lesson on When Will AVs Be Everywhere?.

hook.text: In 2015, experts predicted fully autonomous cars by 2020. It's 2025 and we're still mostly at Level 2.

buildup.text: Robotaxis are live in Phoenix and San Francisco, but they cover a tiny fraction of global roads.

discovery.text: Projections: robotaxis in 20 major cities by 2030, highway autonomy in new cars by 2035, full Level 4 by 2040.

twist.text: The shift won't be sudden. AVs and human drivers will share roads for decades.

climax.text: The technology exists. Regulation, infrastructure, cost, and public trust are the real bottlenecks now.

punchline.text: The tech is ready. The world isn't. Not yet.

quiz.question: What is the biggest bottleneck for AV deployment today?
options: Regulation, infrastructure, cost, and public trust
